text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week manages to find success in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Together, we successfully navigate the crucial first three years of her career.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while still basking in the glory of our accomplishments…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Looking around your office is bringing back so many memories.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: We talked about so many different things. And we worked really hard too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: When I get back to the dorms, I'm gonna write a letter to my mom about my training and all my races…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: And about someone really important to me who's been by my side, watching over me. It's gonna be a really long letter.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm also gonna write a letter to you.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It might end up being a little long… but I hope you read it to the end.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm gonna stay up all night!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Let me just say—thank you so much for the past three years, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: And also… here's to our future together!
